notes.title: Major update - June - V0.1.3
notes.content:
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45548607/093475db7bc918291a62e81b6fd2e7c11f8b7b6b.png"]New planetRV-286
Welcome to RV-286, a brand-new planet featuring three unique tracks. Get ready for a fresh level of speed, strategy, and chaos on a never-seen-before terrain.


New power-upsKamikaze
Overloads your ship until it self-destructs in a powerful EMP pulse, disabling the controls of any opponents caught in the blast.

But beware — if no one is hit, the effect backfires and disables your ship instead.
Virus
Temporarily overrides your ship’s systems, granting unlimited personal turbo. However, once the timer ends, your screen will be blocked for a few seconds.

Want to avoid the penalty? Crash into an opponent before the effect ends to pass the Virus on!
Hellstorm
Calls in a devastating missile strike targeting the area ahead of the leading player. Anyone caught in the blast zone loses control of their ship.


New challengeGhost
A legendary champion from the past has returned to test the new generation. Only the most skilld pilots will receive an invitation to beat Ghost’s time and prove themselves worthy.


General bug fixAI Rework
Reduced the rubber-band effect and enhanced the challenge
Tracks optimization
General optimizations on every tracks
Other minor bug fix

notes.title: MILLENNIUM RUNNERS - Update v0.0.2
notes.content:
On May 9th, first update for Millennium Runners will go live!
A big thank to everyone who has already purchased the game and supported the project with suggestions and feedback.

Version 0.0.2 includes the following updates:


 Improved main menu: Fixed some animations, added a "More Details" screen in the track selection, and implemented a feature that keeps track of your best lap-times and results on each track.
 Vortex Avionics balancing: Thanks to your feedback and comments, we noticed that Vortex Avionics (Blue Icarus) was underperforming. We've improved its performance to match that of other teams.
 General fixes and track optimizations
 Added a “wrong direction” warning signal
 Added starting grids at the beginning of each track — they also help to better visualize where the lap begins and ends
 Enhanced autopilot: Added visual and audio effects to indicate when the power-up is about to end. The autopilot now drives flawlessly and faster than normal
 EMP Rocket fix: An issue where the rocket was fired behind you. Now the rocket will fire from the correct position
 Player position fix: Addressed an issue where the player’s final position could be incorrect at the end of the lap
 Turbo bug fix for speedrunners: An issue where you could spam infinite turbo power-up has been resolved
 Audio settings fix: Master volume now actually applies the selected volume level
 Video settings fix: Removed fullscreen option and adjusted resolution selection
